title: Prioritized customer briefing and RCA execution plan
creator: Amina Patel
description: Goal: produce a prioritized, auditable sequence for customer-facing communications and internal RCA delivery after the 2026-03-08 capacity regression that affected hosted inference throughput in eu-west-1. This ticket coordinates message templates, status page timelines, executive and account-specific briefings, and follow-up commitments for mitigations and credits. Deliverables: 1) consolidated public timeline for status.redwood.com update, 2) curated customer briefing email templates (Tier 1/Tier 2 customers), 3) linked RCA draft for public and internal audiences, 4) customer-specific follow-up tracker mapping affected routes to remediation ETA and compensation decisions, 5) postmortem action item register assigned to owners. Success criteria include stakeholder sign-off (Support, Sales, Legal, Security), statuspage update posted within 3 business days, and outreach to all Tier 1 customers within 48 hours of ticket closure.
acceptance_criteria: Status page timeline posted (public) and matches internal timeline
Tier 1 customer email sent and logged in CRM (with link to public RCA)
Public-facing RCA published under /incidents and linked from status page
Action item register created with owners, estimates, and SLAs for each mitigation
Support & Sales have a triage-ready FAQ and escalation brief for top 10 affected customers
